verdict.rationale: Jeeves' Global Accounts documentation says a founder can manage and receive cash in USD, EUR, GBP and CAD through one business account, backed by multi-currency balances (jeeves-docs-5, jeeves-docs-38). The Boleto/Bolepix API also lets clients create boletos to collect local BRL payments via Pix. However, no evidence says these accounts come with local account details (e.g., IBANs, sort codes, routing numbers) that customers can pay into. Missing for 10: documented local account details per currency, how inbound payments are received and credited, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
